#!/bin/sh
# Sum one nonnegative decimal byte counter per record without fixed-width overflow.

LC_ALL=C
export LC_ALL

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s COUNTERS_FILE\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi

input=$1
if [ ! -r "$input" ]; then
    printf '%s: cannot read counter file: %s\n' "$0" "$input" >&2
    exit 2
fi

expression_file=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/total.py.expression.XXXXXX") || exit 2
output_file=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/total.py.output.XXXXXX") || {
    rm -f "$expression_file"
    exit 2

cleanup() {
    rm -f "$expression_file" "$output_file"

    counter=$(printf '%s\n' "$record" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')
